status: fixed-protocol internal re-evaluation on previously studied corpora; not pristine external confirmation
input: 20 features; velocity zeroed BEFORE extraction for every instrument, no teacher or audio-side inference inputs
split: four outer piece/duplicate-group folds; inner 20% of remaining groups for validation; seed 20260911
selection: minimum validation loss on eight deterministic windows per validation track; evaluation only after training
amp_head: existing note_aware_amp_v2, attention 2 layers / 8 heads / ff1024
matched_training: same crop, objectives, batches, optimizer for both encoders; encoder size differs and is reported
baseline_models: note-level OLS with training-fitted per-instrument shape
statistics: paired bootstrap over unique piece/duplicate groups, 5000 resamples; no significance claims from initialization SD
resumption: atomic epoch checkpoints include model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, best score and completed epoch
scope: paper1 diagnostic analysis only; no ensemble search, external dataset search, or SOTA claims
gpu_sharing: existing processes allowed; require >=24 GiB free before each job; PyTorch allocator cap 20% (~16 GiB); stop on kill/error
